line: When the chest is tight and tomorrow won't sit still

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ
dua.body: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and grief, from incapacity and laziness, from miserliness and cowardice, from the burden of debt and being overpowered by men.

items.title: Anxiety and the Medicine of Ta'weel
items.why: The sermon for the 3am ceiling

items.title: The Morsel of Flesh
items.why: Your heart is the governor of the body — and it can be treated

items.title: Ayyub — The Patient One
items.why: The dua from darkness: 'You are the Most Merciful of the merciful'

line: When something or someone is gone

dua.arabic: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي وَاخْلُفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا
dua.body: Indeed we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we return. O Allah, reward me in my affliction and replace it for me with better.

items.title: The Grammar of Loss
items.why: The sentence that turns a hit into an address

items.title: Umm Salama — Whose Question Became a Verse
items.why: She said the dua — and her replacement was the Messenger ﷺ

items.title: The Beautiful Patience
items.why: Ya'qub held a stained shirt for years — and was right to hope

line: When the heat rises and the tongue loads

dua.body: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Shaytan. Then sit if you stand, and perform wudu — water against fire.

items.title: Yusuf — 'No Blame Upon You'
items.why: The grudge that melted into 'no blame upon you today'

items.title: Play 5: Anger & Argument
items.why: Shaytan pours oil; you carry water

items.title: The Two Rivers of Ibrahim
items.why: The man who smashed idols answered fire with coolness

line: When the crowd is full and the room is empty

dua.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ
dua.body: There is no deity but Allah, the Magnificent, the Forbearing — say it in the loneliness; He is nearer than the vein the loneliness aches in.

items.title: Loneliness in the Crowd
items.why: Five hundred friends and no one to call — and the three doors back

items.title: Maryam — The Palm Tree
items.why: Alone in labor — and provision descended at her feet

items.title: Yunus — The Whale's Belly
items.why: Darker than your dark, and one sentence reached the Throne

line: When the heart is full and you want to say it well

dua.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَجَعَلَنَا مُسْلِمِينَ
dua.body: All praise is for Allah who fed us, gave us drink, and made us Muslims. Gratitude is the wealth that increases — 'if you are grateful, I will surely increase you.'

items.title: The Weight of One Atom
items.why: Gratitude for the small is the deposit that pays at the end

items.title: Sulayman — The Kingdom
items.why: The mightiest king prayed only to be grateful

items.title: The Upper Hand
items.why: Give from the gratitude — 'sadaqah does not decrease wealth'

line: When the tank is empty and the week won't end

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
dua.body: O Allah, help me to remember You, thank You, and worship You well. Rest is written into your design — the night was made for it.

items.title: Built to Rest
items.why: You were built to rest — and Friday is a standing appointment

items.title: The Birds Leave Hungry
items.why: Provision flows to the one who works the morning and releases the outcome

items.title: Before Sleep — Ayat al-Kursi
items.why: A guardian is promised for the night — rest guarded

dua.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ، مَلِكِ النَّاسِ، إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ
dua.body: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, the King of mankind, the God of mankind — the three quls, blown into the hands and wiped over the body, three times.

items.title: Protection from the Jinn
items.why: The fortress is five minutes of habit — never hours of fear

items.title: Ibrahim — The Fire That Cooled
items.why: 'Be coolness and safety upon Ibrahim' — the fire obeyed

items.title: The Hijrah — The Second of Two
items.why: 'Do not grieve; indeed Allah is with us' — said in a cave with hunters at the door

line: When you did the thing and the shame is loud

dua.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الَّذِي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
dua.body: I seek Allah's forgiveness — He besides whom there is no deity, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer — and I turn to Him. The door has no lock on the inside.

items.title: Adam — The First Repentance
items.why: One honest sentence opened the door of mercy for every sinner after him

items.title: The Man Who Killed 99
items.why: The road to paradise, measured in miles of intention

items.title: The Prostitute's Thirst
items.why: One bowl of water — and the ledger was closed by mercy

line: When something good is coming and you can feel it

dua.body: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs — said by the Prophet's ﷺ household, and the favor that followed astonished them.

items.title: Taif — Praying for Your Enemies' Grandchildren
items.why: The dua that refused the mountains and chose the future

items.title: Hudaybiyyah — The Clear Conquest
items.why: The treaty everyone hated opened all of Arabia

items.title: The Queen's Throne
items.why: Power and wisdom can serve the same end: guidance

line: When the map is gone and every road looks the same

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَٰذَا الْأَمْرَ خَيْرٌ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي فَاقْدُرْهُ لِي وَيَسِّرْهُ لِي
dua.body: O Allah, if You know this matter to be good for me in my religion, my livelihood, and my outcome — decree it for me and ease it; and if it is bad, turn it and me away, and decree good for me wherever it is.

items.title: Ibrahim — The Seeker
items.why: He reasoned his way to Allah before a single prophet taught him

items.title: Solitude Is a Room
items.why: The quiet hour is part of the house of the deen, not an escape from it

line: When the heart is quiet and you want to keep it

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَىٰ وَالتُّقَىٰ وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَىٰ
dua.body: O Allah, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity, and self-sufficiency — the Prophet ﷺ would say this in his prayer. Peace is not the absence of trouble; it is the presence of sufficiency in Allah.

items.title: Solitude Is a Room
items.why: Protect the quiet — it is part of the house of the deen

items.title: Built to Rest
items.why: Rest is written into your design; keep the appointment

items.title: The Three Men in the Cave
items.why: Honest deeds held a sealed cave — peace is built the same way

line: When everything is due and there is only one of you

dua.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
dua.body: There is no deity but Allah alone, without partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is over all things able. The Prophet ﷺ said: whoever says it in distress, Allah frees him from it.

items.title: Built to Rest
items.why: The night was made for rest — and Friday is a legal stop

items.title: The Birds Leave Hungry
items.why: Work the morning; release the outcome

items.title: Before Sleep — Ayat al-Kursi
items.why: The night has a Guardian you do not pay
